question: A network of computers and other devices that are confined to a relatively small space is called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Local Area Network**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A local area network is a network of computers and other devices confined to a relatively small area.
 
• Local Area Network is used for connecting different devices in a small geographical area for sharing different resources like printers, plotters etc. or some files need to be accessed by more than one device.
 
• A topology for a Local Area Network in which all nodes are individually connected to a central connection point like a hub or switch is called Star Topology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Wide Area Network:

 
 
• A wide area network (WAN) is a data network, usually used for connecting computers, that spans a wide geographical area.
 
• WANs can be used to connect cities, states, or even countries. 
 
 
 
• P2P Stands for the "Peer to Peer" network, the "peers" are computer systems that are interconnected to each other via the Interne
